result.summary: The 2024 page replaces the 2023 'Guiding Principles' set with a new values section (Integrity, Safety, Collaboration, Creativity, Reliability, Respect) and drops 'We compete to win', the DEI inclusion commitment and the R&D/shareholders/communities continuous-improvement statement. It adds sustainability and community-wellbeing headlines and product showcases, and shifts emphasis toward safety, sustainability and product innovation.
